summary: CXMT's second 12-inch DRAM production line in Hefei, Anhui, run by its subsidiary Changxin Xinqiao, which was set up in January 2021 and is co-owned with China's national chip fund and Hefei city investors. CXMT's December 2025 STAR Market prospectus lists three CXMT 12-inch DRAM fabs and shows heavy construction spending on the Hefei phase 2 line from 2022, most of it moved into fixed assets in 2024, a year in which a new CXMT line entered production. Trade press reported the second Hefei fab making DDR5 on a 17nm process at about 50,000 wafers a month at the end of 2024, with another 50,000 expected in 2025. In July 2026 a reporter found further phase 2 construction, including work tied to a FAB A2B building, still under way, and CXMT's 2026 half-year report put the line's budget at about CNY 94 billion, 97 percent spent.

milestones.note: Derived, not stated per fab: the prospectus says new CXMT lines started up in 2022 and 2024 without naming them; 2024 is the year most of this line's construction moved into fixed assets and Changxin Xinqiao reported about CNY 3.2 billion of revenue, and trade press reported the fab in production by December 2024. No source gives the exact start date.

notes: Status is partly operating because the line produced from 2024 while a July 2026 report found more phase 2 construction still in progress and the 2026 half-year report still lists construction in progress on the line; the report links the FAB A2B building to Changxin Xinqiao through a 2023 engineering contract. The 2024 production start is derived, not stated per fab: the prospectus says new lines started up in 2022 and 2024 without naming them, and this line moved no assets into service in 2022. The prospectus does not give per-fab capacity or start dates. It reports the Hefei phase 2 line's construction in progress at about CNY 13.8 billion on 30 June 2025, after transfers to fixed assets of about CNY 9.2 billion in 2023, CNY 46.6 billion in 2024 and CNY 16.1 billion in the first half of 2025; the half-year report gives about CNY 5.1 billion on 30 June 2026. These accounting figures are not recorded as investment. The 2026 listing proceeds are earmarked for upgrading existing lines and DRAM technology and for research, not for new fabs.
